cookie.title: Cookie Policy
cookie.p1: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are and how we use them, the types of cookies we use i.e, the information we collect using cookies and how that information is used, and how to manage the cookie settings.
cookie.p2: Cookies are small text files that are used to store small pieces of information. They are stored on your device when the website is loaded on your browser. These cookies help us make the website function properly, make it more secure, provide better user experience, and understand how the website performs and to analyze what works and where it needs improvement.
cookie.p3: As most of the online services, our website uses first-party and third-party cookies for several purposes. First-party cookies are mostly necessary for the website to function the right way, and they do not collect any of your personally identifiable data.
cookie.p4: The third-party cookies used on our website are mainly for understanding how the website performs, how you interact with our website, keeping our services secure, providing advertisements that are relevant to you, and all in all providing you with a better and improved user experience and help speed up your future interactions with our website.
cookie.p5: You can change your cookie preferences any time by clicking the above button. This will let you revisit the cookie consent banner and change your preferences or withdraw your consent right away.
cookie.p6: In addition to this, different browsers provide different methods to block and delete cookies used by websites. You can change the settings of your browser to block/delete the cookies. Listed below are the links to the support documents on how to manage and delete cookies from the major web browsers.
cookie.p7: If you are using any other web browser, please visit your browser's official support documents.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.html:
Terms and Conditions

Tokenkey Solutions Germany GmbH
(Platform Terms & Conditions)

1. Scope and Applicability

These Terms and Conditions ("Terms") govern the use of the Tokenkey platform ("Platform") operated by Tokenkey Solutions Germany GmbH, Mainzer Landstraße 69, 60329 Frankfurt am Main, Germany ("Tokenkey").

These Terms apply to all users accessing the Platform in connection with the subscription of tokenized financial instruments ("Security Tokens").

2. Regulatory Status

Tokenkey Solutions Germany GmbH acts as a contractually tied agent (vertraglich gebundener Vermittler) within the meaning of Section 3 (2) of the German Securities Institutions Act (WpIG) under the liability umbrella of CONCEDUS GmbH, Ostendstraße 100, 90482 Nuremberg, Germany ("Concedus"), a BaFin-regulated investment firm.

The registration of Tokenkey Solutions Germany GmbH as a tied agent in the public BaFin register is subject to the completion of the onboarding process.

Tokenkey does not provide investment advice, portfolio management, or custody services.

3. Services Provided

Tokenkey provides a technical and organizational platform enabling users to:

  • Access information on tokenized financial instruments,
  • Complete legally required KYC and appropriateness checks,
  • Submit subscription declarations for Security Tokens.

Tokenkey does not:

  • Receive or hold client funds,
  • Issue financial instruments in its own name,
  • Act as custodian or wallet provider.

4. No Investment Advice

All information provided on the Platform is for information purposes only and does not constitute investment advice, investment recommendation, or solicitation.

Users are solely responsible for assessing whether an investment is suitable for their personal financial situation and risk tolerance.

5. User Eligibility

The Platform is intended exclusively for users who are legally permitted to invest in financial instruments under applicable law.

Access may be restricted based on jurisdictional, regulatory, or compliance considerations.

6. KYC, AML and Appropriateness Checks

Prior to any subscription, users must complete:

  • Identity verification (KYC),
  • Anti-money laundering checks (AML),
  • Appropriateness assessments in accordance with regulatory requirements.

These processes are conducted in cooperation with regulated service providers and under the compliance framework of Concedus.

7. Subscription Process

The subscription process includes:

  1. User registration and verification,
  2. Provision of mandatory legal and risk disclosures,
  3. Submission of a binding subscription declaration,
  4. Confirmation of the subscription.

A confirmation email containing all relevant documents will be sent to the user after submission.

8. Risks

Investments in Security Tokens involve significant risks, including the risk of total loss.

Users acknowledge that tokenized financial instruments are not risk-free and that past performance is not indicative of future results.

9. Custody of Security Tokens

Custody of Security Tokens is provided exclusively by a regulated third-party custodian, currently Tangany GmbH, Munich, Germany.

Tokenkey:

  • Does not hold private keys,
  • Does not have control over user assets,
  • Does not provide wallet services.

10. Payments

Payments in connection with subscriptions are processed via regulated payment service providers.

Tokenkey does not receive or hold client funds at any time.

11. Secondary Market (Planned)

The Platform currently does not provide a secondary market for Security Tokens.

A secondary market functionality is planned for a future phase, subject to:

  • Regulatory approval by BaFin,
  • Availability of the service via Nyala as a regulated technology provider,
  • Additional legal and compliance approvals.

No secondary market trading is available at present.

12. Liability

Tokenkey shall be liable only for damages caused by intent or gross negligence, subject to mandatory statutory provisions.

Concedus assumes liability for the investment intermediation activities of Tokenkey in its capacity as liability umbrella.

13. Data Protection

Personal data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the GDPR.

Further details are provided in the Privacy Policy available on the Platform.

14. Amendments

Tokenkey reserves the right to amend these Terms where necessary due to legal, regulatory, or operational changes.

Users will be informed of material changes.

15. Governing Law and Jurisdiction

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany.

The courts of Frankfurt am Main shall have jurisdiction, unless mandatory consumer protection rules apply.

16. Language

The German version of these Terms is legally binding.
